scope: robust label-free same-site temporal template ranker cross-fitted only on MARS folds 3 and 4
rationale: The full-bank Gaussian contrast ViT transferred dense localization but not complementary scene ordering. The current official failure is confined to unseen-site AP/recall uncertainty, and the earlier site-relative model used a mean template. Median and interquartile residuals directly suppress transient plume contamination and normalize site-specific variability without labels.

images.access: only rows aligned to the folds34 manifest are indexed

architecture.template: per physical site and pixel/channel, compute q25, median, and q75 across all label-free eligible observations
feature_sets: original maps plus median plus signed original-median residual
architecture.ranker: 974,034-parameter compact residual spatial CNN for the 18-channel robust feature set; sensor embedding and attention/mean/max pooling
architecture.current_identity_floor: candidate=logit_blend(current, ranker, weight); mathematical identity at weight 0

training.positive_weight: sqrt(weighted negatives / weighted positives), capped at 4
training.augmentation: joint right-angle rotations and horizontal/vertical reflections
training.determinism: torch deterministic algorithms and deterministic cuDNN

search.selection_rank: all gates, worst-fold AP, worst-fold recall, worst-sensor AP, paired-site AP lower bound, pooled AP, then smaller blend

gates.pass_action: freeze a new-seed fold-2 confirmation; do not open folds 0/1 or official outcomes

invariants: Only folds 3 and 4 labels, sensors, groups, and current scores are loaded.
The all-fold spatial metadata contributes identities, groups, and channel names only; its labels are never read.
Each held score is produced by a ranker fitted only on the opposite fold.
Site templates are label-free and every physical site belongs wholly to one fold.
Fold 2, folds 0/1, external development outcomes, and official-test outcomes are unavailable for selection.
Bulk arrays and model artifacts remain ignored.
